annotations.title: Read the text of a frame

description: Read the story of a text frame: story_id, story_length, paragraphs[] {index, start_index, end_index (exclusive, without the break), end_index_incl_break, paragraph_style, text, is_empty, break_type (paragraph, column, frame, page, odd_page, even_page or none for the last paragraph)} and overset for this frame. Column breaks count like paragraph marks; zero-width characters (U+FEFF) are returned as they are. For a threaded frame the whole story is returned, with frame_start_index and frame_end_index marking this frame's portion – pass only_frame_portion true to get only the paragraphs in this frame (text clipped at the frame boundaries, clipped_start/clipped_end mark the cut), and max_chars to cap the text returned (truncated true, paragraphs_omitted counts the rest). Indices always refer to the whole story, so they can be used with set_text_in_range and the *_to_range tools. Also lock_state of the story (none, unmanaged_story, checked_in_story, checked_out_story, locked_story, embedded_story, missing_lock_state, mixed_lock_state; null when unreadable) and managed_file (path of the editorial file for a managed story, home folder as ~; otherwise null) – writing tools refuse checked_in_story, locked_story, missing_lock_state and mixed_lock_state. Read-only. There is no include_overset parameter.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

max_chars.description: Budget for the text returned across all paragraphs; the rest is counted in paragraphs_omitted.

only_frame_portion.description: true: only the paragraphs shown in this frame, text clipped at its boundaries. Default false = whole story.

show_placeholders.description: Show special characters in text as {{…}} placeholders (line_break, nbsp, nbsp_fixed, thin_space, hair_space, soft_hyphen, nb_hyphen, en_dash, em_dash, tab, column_break, frame_break, page_break). Default false. Indices stay story-wide; each placeholder stands for one character.
